transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Yeah, um… I’m here because I’m having trouble stopping myself from rechecking my work. I’m an electrician, and lately even a pretty simple install turns into this whole thing where I keep going back over the breakers, the labels, torque marks, photos I took… sometimes I’ll even drive back to a job site because I can’t let it go.

It’s making jobs take way longer than they should. And, you know, customers don’t always notice at first, but coworkers do, and my boss is starting to. I used to be the guy who was just careful, which is a good thing in electrical work—my dad used to say “measure twice,” all that—but this is more like… I can’t move on. It’s getting embarrassing.
Do you feel anxious or upset if you can’t go back and check your work, or if someone stops you from rechecking?

Yeah, I mean… it gets to me if I can’t. That’s kind of the whole reason I came in. I’ll finish a job and then I’m supposed to just pack up and go, but my head keeps pulling me back to the breakers, the labels, the torque marks—like, “Did I really do that right?” even if I already checked.

And then I’ll look at the photos I took, which should settle it, but sometimes it doesn’t. I’ve even driven back to a site, which is ridiculous because gas isn’t cheap and traffic around here—well, depending on the time of day it can be a nightmare. But anyway, yeah, if someone says, “No, we’re done, let’s go,” I can get pretty worked up inside. A simple install ends up taking way longer than it should, and people are starting to notice.
Do you find yourself doing specific things over and over again, like taking photos a certain way or checking things in a particular order, because it feels like you have to?

Yeah, I do. I mean, it’s not like a ritual exactly—well, maybe it kind of is. I’ll go back over the same things: breakers, labels, torque marks, then the photos I took. Sometimes I tell myself I’m just being thorough, because with electrical work you don’t want to be sloppy. My old foreman used to say the one mistake you don’t catch is the one that bites you, and that stuck with me.

But now it’s gotten to where I’ll check them again and again, even after it should be done. And sometimes I’ll leave and still not feel right, so I end up driving back to the site. A simple install takes way longer than it should, and people are starting to notice, which… yeah, that’s embarrassing.
